item.title: Cyber Hankuk University of Foreign Studies Recruits New and Transfer Students for Second Round of 2026 Academic Year Second Semester… Selection in 10 Departments Until Next Month's 18th (사이버한국외국어대학교 2026학년도 2학기 신·편입생 2차 모집… 내달 18일까지 10개 학부에서 선발)
item.description:
Cyber Hankuk University of Foreign Studies (hereafter Cyber Hankuk University of Foreign Studies, President Moon Hwi-chang) will conduct an additional recruitment of new and transfer students for the second semester of the 2026 academic year from Thursday, July 30, to Tuesday, August 18. (사이버한국외국어대학교(이하 사이버한국외대, 총장 문휘창)가 7월 30일(목)부터 8월 18일(화)까지 2026학년도 2학기 신·편입생 추가 모집을 실시한다.)

At Cyber Hankuk University of Foreign Studies, all academic processes including classes and exams are operated 100% online, offering an optimized learning environment for office workers and homemakers who need to balance work and study. Upon graduation, students receive a regular four-year bachelor's degree identical to that of graduates from traditional universities. While enrolled, students can also concurrently complete certificate courses, joint operation certificate programs with prestigious overseas universities, and micro-degrees that provide practical help in strengthening job competencies and facilitating career transitions. (사이버한국외대는 수업과 시험 등 모든 학사 과정이 100% 온라인으로 운영되어 일과 학습을 병행해야 하는 직장인과 주부에게 최적화된 학습 환경을 제공한다. 졸업 시에는 일반대학교 졸업자와 동일한 정규 4년제 학사학위가 수여되며, 재학 중에는 직무역량 강화와 커리어 전환에 실질적인 도움이 되는 자격증·해외 명문대학 공동 운영 수료증 과정과 마이크로디그리 등을 함께 이수할 수 있다.)

True to its reputation as the nation's only foreign language-specialized cyber university, Cyber Hankuk University of Foreign Studies operates a total of 10 departments, including six foreign language departments (English, Chinese, Japanese, Korean, Spanish, and Vietnamese/Indonesian) encompassing language, society, culture, politics, economics, and regional studies, and four departments specialized in fostering practical experts in social sciences and applied fields (Business Administration, Industrial Safety & Housing Management, Counseling Psychology, and K-Beauty). Based on this, it provides Cyber Hankuk University of Foreign Studies' differentiated 'career-enabling' education along three axes: ▲Global specialized curriculum of 'language + culture' ▲Convergence curriculum of 'language + applied studies' ▲Curriculum for acquiring 'practical education + promising certifications'. Recently, it has actively introduced AI-based learning environments and is striving to nurture future-oriented talents by enhancing learning effectiveness through AI-utilized educational content and various digital learning support services, while reflecting competencies needed in the rapidly changing industrial environment into its curriculum. (국내 유일의 외국어 특성화 사이버대학교라는 명성에 걸맞게 사이버한국외대는 언어, 사회, 문화, 정치, 경제, 지역학을 아우르는 6개의 외국어학부(영어, 중국어, 일본어, 한국어, 스페인어, 베트남·인도네시아)와 실무 전문가 육성에 특화된 사회과학·실용 4개 학부(경영, 산업안전·주택관리, 상담심리, K뷰티)의 도합 10개 학부를 운영한다. 이를 토대로 ▲‘외국어+문화’의 글로벌 특화 교육과정 ▲‘언어+실용학문’의 융복합 교육과정 ▲‘실용교육+유망 자격증’ 취득과정의 세 가지 축으로 사이버한국외대만의 차별화된, ‘커리어가 되는’ 교육을 제공한다. 최근에는 AI 기반 학습 환경을 적극 도입하고 AI를 활용한 교육 콘텐츠와 다양한 디지털 학습 지원 서비스를 통해 학습 효과를 높이는 한편, 급변하는 산업 환경에 필요한 역량을 교육과정에 반영하며 미래형 인재 양성에 힘쓰고 있다.)

New and transfer students for the second semester of the 2026 academic year are recruited from a total of 10 departments: ▲Department of English, ▲Department of Chinese, ▲Department of Japanese, ▲Department of Korean, ▲Department of Spanish, ▲Department of Vietnamese/Indonesian, ▲Department of Business Administration, ▲Department of Industrial Safety & Housing Management, ▲Department of Counseling Psychology, and ▲Department of K-Beauty. Applicants for new admission must be graduates of domestic or foreign high schools or have equivalent academic qualifications recognized. Those who have graduated (or are expected to graduate) from domestic or foreign junior colleges or higher can obtain degrees more efficiently through transfer admission to the second or third year. (2026학년도 2학기 신·편입생은 ▲영어학부 ▲중국어학부 ▲일본어학부 ▲한국어학부 ▲스페인어학부 ▲베트남·인도네시아학부 ▲경영학부 ▲산업안전·주택관리학부 ▲상담심리학부 ▲K뷰티학부 등 총 10개 학부에서 모집한다. 신입학은 국내외 고등학교 졸업자 또는 이에 준하는 학력이 인정되는 경우 지원 가능하며, 국내외 전문대학 졸업(예정)자 이상은 2학년 또는 3학년 편입학을 통해 보다 효율적으로 학위를 취득할 수 있다.)

Admission evaluation criteria reflect only the scores from the self-introduction letter (70%) and the academic aptitude test (30%) written and taken upon application, and do not consider high school grades, college scholastic ability test scores, or previous university credits. Applicants who complete the submission of application, evaluation procedures, and required documents within the second recruitment period will be eligible. (입학전형 기준에는 입학 지원 시 작성하고 응시하는 자기소개서(70%)와 학업소양검사(30%) 점수만이 반영되며, 고교 내신이나 수능, 전적대학 학점 등은 평가하지 않는다. 지원자는 2차 모집 기간 내 원서접수와 전형 절차 및 구비서류 제출을 완료하면 된다.)

Detailed information on the second round of recruitment for new and transfer students for the second semester of the 2026 academic year at Cyber Hankuk University of Foreign Studies can be found at the Admission Support Center (go.cufs.ac.kr). Inquiries or individual consultations regarding admissions are available by phone (02-2173-2580), KakaoTalk (ID: cufs), or email (ipsi@cufs.ac.kr). (사이버한국외국어대학교 2026학년도 2학기 신·편입생 2차 모집에 대한 자세한 사항은 입학지원센터(go.cufs.ac.kr)에서 확인할 수 있으며, 입학 관련 문의나 개별 상담은 전화(02-2173-2580)와 카카오톡(ID: cufs), 이메일(ipsi@cufs.ac.kr)로 가능하다.)

item.title: Professor Ham Seung-su of Myongji University Graduate School of Education Appointed as 'Mid- to Long-Term National Education Development Expert' at the National Education Commission (명지대 교육대학원 함승수 교수, 국가교육위원회 ‘중장기 국가교육발전 전문위원’ 위촉)
item.description:
Myongji University (President Lim Yeon-soo) announced that Professor Ham Seung-su of the Graduate School of Education has been appointed as a member of the 'Mid- to Long-Term National Education Development Expert Committee' under the National Education Commission. (명지대학교(총장 임연수)는 교육대학원 함승수 교수가 국가교육위원회 산하 ‘중장기 국가교육발전 전문위원회’ 위원으로 위촉됐다고 밝혔다.)

The Mid- to Long-Term National Education Development Expert Committee is a key body among the three expert committees under the National Education Commission. It plays a role in deliberating and advising on overall national education policies, including university admissions, private schools, and alternative education, to establish the mid- to long-term vision for South Korea's education and the national education development plan. (중장기 국가교육발전 전문위원회는 국가교육위원회 산하 3개 전문위원회 중 핵심 기구다. 대한민국 교육의 중장기 비전과 국가교육발전계획 수립을 위해 대학입시, 사립학교, 대안교육 등 국가 교육정책 전반을 심의하고 자문하는 역할을 담당한다.)

()

Professor Ham will serve as an expert member until December 2028, participating in the deliberation and advisory process for major national mid- to long-term education policies, including improvements to the university admissions system, private school and alternative education policies, as well as the formulation of the national education development plan. (함승수 교수는 오는 2028년 12월까지 전문위원으로 활동하며, 대학입시 제도 개선을 비롯해 사립학교 및 대안교육 정책 등 주요 국가 중장기 교육정책 수립과 국가교육발전계획 심의·자문에 참여할 예정이다.)

()

An expert in education policy, religious private schools, Christian schools, and alternative education, Professor Ham currently serves as a professor at Myongji University's Graduate School of Education and as the Director of the Education Mission Center. Additionally, as the Secretary-General of the Private School Corporation Mission Network, which involves approximately 500 Christian private schools nationwide, he has continuously conducted policy research to enhance the autonomy of religious private schools, expand educational diversity, and improve institutional frameworks. (교육정책, 종교계 사립학교, 기독교학교 및 대안교육 분야 전문가인 함 교수는 현재 명지대 교육대학원 교수 및 교육미션센터장을 맡고 있다. 아울러 전국 500여 개 기독사학이 참여하는 사학법인미션네트워크 사무총장으로서 종교계 사립학교의 자율성 신장과 교육 다양성 확대, 제도 개선을 위한 정책 연구를 지속해 왔다.)

()

Recently, he has provided policy advice to the National Education Commission, the Ministry of Education, and the National Assembly, while accumulating research achievements in various areas such as the high school credit system, Christian school curricula, institutional improvements for alternative schools and alternative education institutions, and ensuring educational diversity and autonomy. (최근에는 국가교육위원회, 교육부, 국회 등을 대상으로 정책 자문을 수행하는 한편 고교학점제, 기독교학교 교육과정, 대안학교 및 대안교육기관 제도 개선, 교육 다양성과 자율성 보장 등 다양한 영역에서 연구 성과를 축적해 왔다.)

()

Professor Ham expressed his thoughts, saying, "I will engage in a balanced discussion on the pressing educational issues our society faces, such as the decline in the school-age population, educational disparities, nurturing future talent, reforming university admissions, and developing private schools and alternative education," adding, "I will do my utmost with a sense of responsibility to formulate sustainable national education development plans that harmonize diversity, autonomy, and public interest in education." (함승수 교수는 “학령인구 감소와 교육격차, 미래인재 양성, 대학입시 개편, 사립학교와 대안교육 발전 등 우리 사회가 직면한 교육 현안을 균형 있게 논의하겠다”며 “교육의 다양성, 자율성, 공공성이 조화를 이루는 지속가능한 국가교육 발전 방안을 마련하는 데 책임감을 가지고 최선을 다하겠다”고 소감을 밝혔다.)

()

With this appointment, Professor Ham's expertise accumulated in the educational field and academia is expected to be directly reflected in the establishment of national mid- to long-term education policies. Furthermore, it is anticipated to serve as an opportunity to link Myongji University's educational and research capabilities with the national decision-making system, enhancing the university's policy status and expanding external cooperation. (이번 위촉으로 함승수 교수가 교육 현장과 학계에서 축적해 온 전문성이 국가 중장기 교육정책 수립에 직접 반영될 것으로 기대된다. 나아가 명지대학교의 교육·연구 역량을 국가 의사결정 체계와 연계해 대학의 정책적 위상을 높이고 대외 협력을 확대하는 계기가 될 전망이다.)

item.title: Hana Financial Group Pushes 4 Trillion Won PF for 'Jamsil Dome Baseball Stadium' Complex Development (하나금융, ‘잠실 돔 야구장’ 복합공간 조성 4조원 PF 추진)
item.description:
Hana Securities and Hana Bank are promoting a 4 trillion won project financing (PF) to develop a dome baseball stadium, convention and sports complex, among other facilities, on a 350,000㎡ site around Jamsil Sports Complex. (하나증권과 하나은행이 잠실종합운동장 일대 35만㎡ 부지에 돔 야구장, 컨벤션·스포츠콤플렉스 등을 조성하는 4조원 규모 프로젝트파이낸싱(PF)을 추진한다.)

Hana Securities and Hana Bank announced on the 30th that they will participate as the lead and joint financial arranger for the 'Jamsil Sports and MICE Complex Creation Private Investment Project,' initiating a 4 trillion won project financing (PF). This project is the largest private investment project for a mixed-use facility in the country, involving the construction of exhibition and convention facilities, a dome baseball stadium, a sports complex, and accommodation, commercial, and office facilities on approximately 350,000㎡ of land around Jamsil Sports Complex. (하나증권과 하나은행은 30일 ‘잠실 스포츠·마이스(MICE) 복합공간 조성 민간투자사업’의 대표 및 공동 금융주관사로 참여해 4조원 규모의 프로젝트파이낸싱(PF)에 나선다고 밝혔다. 이 사업은 잠실종합운동장 일대 약 35만㎡ 부지에 전시·컨벤션시설과 돔 야구장, 스포츠콤플렉스, 숙박·상업·업무시설 등을 조성하는 국내 최대 규모의 복합시설 민간투자사업이다.)

The Seoul Metropolitan Government and the project operator, Seoul Smart MICE Park (tentative name), signed an implementation agreement on the 28th to proceed with the project. Seoul Smart MICE Park is a project company to be established for this initiative, with Hanwha Engineering & Construction serving as the lead firm and construction, operation, and financial investors participating as shareholders. Previously, in December 2021, Hana Financial Group formed the '3H Consortium' with Hanwha Engineering & Construction and IPARK Hyundai Development (formerly HDC Hyundai Development), and was selected as the preferred bidder, leading to this implementation agreement. (서울시와 사업시행자인 서울스마트마이스파크(가칭)는 지난 28일 사업 추진을 위한 실시협약을 체결했다. 서울스마트마이스파크는 사업 추진을 위해 설립될 예정인 사업시행법인으로, 한화 건설부문이 대표사를 맡고 건설·운영·재무적투자자 등이 출자자로 참여한다. 앞서 2021년 12월 하나금융그룹은 한화 건설부문과 아이파크현대산업개발(옛 HDC현대산업개발) 등과 함께 ‘3H 컨소시엄’을 구성해 우선협상대상자로 선정된 이후 이번에 실시 협약이 체결됐다.)

Hana Financial Group stated, "In line with the 'One IB' collaboration strategy being pursued to accelerate the execution of group-level productive and investment financing, we are combining the capabilities of Hana Securities and Hana Bank to design the financial structure and secure PF financing. Hana Securities will participate as a financial investor in Seoul Smart MICE Park and as the lead financial arranger, while Hana Bank will join as a co-financial arranger. We have completed the formation of the lender group for financial procurement." (하나금융그룹은 “그룹 차원의 생산적·투자 금융 실행 속도를 높이기 위해 추진 중인 ‘One IB’ 협업 전략에 맞춰 하나증권과 하나은행의 역량을 결집해 금융구조 설계와 PF 금융조달을 추진한다. 하나증권은 서울스마트마이스파크의 재무적투자자이자 대표 금융주관사로, 하나은행은 공동 금융주관사로 참여한다. 금융조달을 위한 대주단 구성을 완료했다.)

item.title: Park Hong-geun: "Education Grant Trend Maintained...Surplus Funds for Higher, Lifelong, and Early Childhood Education" (박홍근 “교육교부금 추세 유지…남은 돈은 고등·평생·유아 교육에”)
item.description:
Minister of Strategy and Finance Park Hong-geun stated on the 30th that regarding the Local Education Financial Grant (education grant), he intends to maintain the trend of an annual increase of around 6% that has continued for the past 20 years. The plan is to reform the current education grant system, which automatically allocates a fixed percentage of domestic taxes, while guaranteeing an increase at the level of the long-term trend line. (박홍근 기획예산처 장관이 30일 지방교육재정교부금(교육교부금)과 관련해 지난 20년간 이어진 연 6%대 증가 추세는 유지하겠다고 말했다. 내국세의 일정 비율을 자동으로 배분하는 현 교육교부금 제도는 개편하되, 장기추세선 수준의 증가는 보장하겠다는 취지다.)

Appearing on the YouTube channel 'Jang Yoon-seon's Reporting Convenience Store' that day, Minister Park said, "Over the past 20 years, the education grant has been increasing at a trend of around 6%. We will guarantee that trend," and added, "The remaining funds will be used for higher education, lifelong education, and early childhood education." (박 장관은 이날 유튜브 ‘장윤선의 취재편의점’에 출연해 “지난 20년 동안 교육교부금이 쭉 올라온 추세가 6%대다. 그 추세만큼 보장해 주겠다”며 “남은 돈은 고등교육, 평생교육, 유아교육에 쓰겠다”고 말했다.)

The education grant is a budget allocated to metropolitan and provincial offices of education that oversee elementary, middle, and high school education. According to related laws, 20.79% of domestic tax revenue is automatically assigned, so even as the school-age population decreases, the education grant increases if the national finances grow. With expectations of massive additional semiconductor tax revenues this year and next, voices are growing for a change in the current grant calculation method, though specific reform measures have not been finalized due to opposition from the education sector. (교육교부금이란 초·중·고 교육을 관할하는 시·도 교육청에 배분되는 예산이다. 관련법에 따라 내국세 수입의 20.79%가 자동으로 배정돼, 학령인구가 줄어도 국가재정이 커지면 교육교부금은 늘어나게 된다. 올해와 내년 막대한 반도체 추가세수가 예상되면서 현재의 교부금 산정방식을 바꿔야 한다는 목소리가 커지고 있지만, 교육계 반발 등으로 구체적인 개편 방안은 정해지지 않았다.)

Minister Park stated, "Although the school-age population has rapidly declined, the education grant has astronomically increased, leading to wasteful spending in some regions, and both the National Assembly and the Board of Audit and Inspection have called for system improvements," adding, "The idea is to create a new system this time by reflecting the decline in the school-age population." He further said, "The grant per student is around 13 million won per year, the highest level among OECD countries. I will never reduce the total grant amount or the grant per student," and added, "Then, the remaining funds will be invested in higher education, etc. Lifelong education goes without saying, and shouldn't we also invest in early childhood education?" <<> Regarding the newly established Future Response Fund, he described it as "a considerable scale" and announced that the government would pursue legislative amendments to establish the fund through government-led legislation. The Future Response Fund is a resource that accumulates large-scale additional tax revenues generated from booms like semiconductors and invests them in future industries, youth, regions, and education. Minister Park explained, "I plan to propose the bill as government legislation around late August or early September when the next year's government budget plan is submitted," and added, "As this involves creating a large-scale fund in a new way, I judged it right to handle this matter with enhanced government accountability." He refrained from giving specifics on the fund's size, saying, "It will be revealed when we present next year's budget." <<> Meanwhile, Minister Park criticized remarks by National Assembly Speaker Woo Won-shik, who said, "The issue of constitutional amendment for a sitting president's re-election is ultimately a matter of the people's choice," calling them "remarks that burden the president's state affairs." He added, "Even if a constitutional amendment changes the single-term system, it is common knowledge that it wouldn't apply to the current president," noting, "The president has already repeatedly stated that constitutional amendment is impossible." <<> Reporter Shin Min-jung shin@hani.co.kr (박 장관은 “학령인구가 급속히 감소했는데 교육교부금은 천문학적으로 올라가다 보니 방만하게 쓰는 지역도 있고, 국회와 감사원에서도 제도 개선을 하라고 했다”며 “이번 기회에 학령인구 감소분을 반영해서 새롭게 제도를 만들자는 것”이라고 했다. 그러면서 “학생 1인당 교부금이 매년 1300만원 정도로 경제협력개발기구(OECD) 최고 수준이다. 교부금 총액이나 학생 1인당 교부금은 결코 줄이지 않겠다”며 “그렇게 하고 나서 남은 돈은 고등교육 등에 투자하겠다. 평생교육은 말할 것도 없고, 유아교육에도 투자해야 하지 않겠나”라고 했다.)

item.title: Bid-rigging cartel worth 10 trillion won in biofuels… Fair Trade Commission begins deliberations (바이오연료 10조 규모 ‘들러리 입찰 담합’…공정위, 심의 착수)
item.description:
The Fair Trade Commission (FTC) has initiated sanctions procedures against seven manufacturers and sellers who colluded on the volume and price of biofuel bids for over 11 years. The scale of the bids affected by the collusion is close to 10 trillion won, and if confirmed, the fines alone could reach up to 2 trillion won. (공정거래위원회가 11년 넘게 바이오연료 입찰 물량과 가격을 담합한 7개 제조·판매사에 대한 제재 절차에 착수했다. 담합 영향을 받은 입찰 규모만 10조원에 육박해, 확정될 경우 과징금만 최대 2조원에 이를 수 있다.)

On the 30th, the FTC’s Office of General Counsel submitted a review report containing the investigation results and proposed sanctions regarding the biofuel bid-rigging case to the commission, and announced that the deliberation process had begun as the report was sent to the businesses. The recipients of the review report are seven companies: DS Dansuk, AK Chemical, SK Ecoprime, SK Chemical, Emax Solution, JC Chemical, and KG Eco Solution. (공정위 사무처는 30일 바이오연료 입찰 담합 사건 관련 조사 결과 및 제재 의견을 담은 심사보고서를 위원회에 제출하고, 사업자에게 송부해 심의 절차가 개시됐다고 밝혔다. 심사보고서 송부 대상은 디에스단석, 애경케미칼, 에스케이에코프라임, 에스케이케미칼, 이맥솔루션, 제이씨케미칼, 케이지에코솔루션 등 7개사다.)

According to the FTC's investigation, these seven companies systematically executed bid-rigging and volume allocation agreements for biofuel bids over 11 years and 3 months, from December 2013 to February 2025. The investigation revealed a typical cover-bidding structure, where a specific company was pre-determined as the successful bidder, and the remaining companies adjusted their bids accordingly. (공정위 조사 결과, 이들 7개 업체는 2013년 12월부터 2025년 2월까지 11년3개월에 걸쳐 조직적으로 바이오연료 입찰 담합 및 물량 배분 합의를 실행한 것으로 나타났다. 특정 업체가 미리 낙찰 예정자로 정해지면 나머지 사업자들이 입찰가를 조정해 내는 전형적인 들러리 담합 구조였던 것으로 조사됐다.)

The total value of bids affected by this collusion was found to amount to approximately 9.7 trillion won (7.76 trillion won for biodiesel and 1.95 trillion won for bio heavy oil). Under the Fair Trade Act, bid-rigging can result in fines of up to 20% of the relevant sales revenue, and since the sales calculated for the penalty also include the amounts from cover bidders, it is usually calculated to be larger than the total bid volume (9.7 trillion won). Even with simple calculations, the maximum statutory penalty limit exceeds 2 trillion won. (이 사건 담합으로 영향을 받은 입찰 규모는 총 9조7천여억원(바이오디젤 7조7600억원, 바이오중유 1조9500억원)에 달하는 것으로 파악됐다. 공정거래법상 입찰담합은 관련 매출액의 최대 20%까지 과징금을 부과할 수 있는데다, 실제 부과 대상 매출액 산정 시 들러리 참가액까지 더해져 통상 입찰 규모(9조7000억원)보다 크게 산정된다. 단순 계산상으로도 법정 최대 부과액 한도가 2조원을 넘기게 된다.)

Biodiesel is a fuel that oil refiners are mandated to mix (4%) into transportation diesel under the Renewable Fuel Standard (RFS), and they purchase it through bidding. Bio heavy oil is a fuel for power generation procured through bidding by major power companies to supply a certain percentage (15.0%) of their total power generation under the Renewable Portfolio Standard (RPS). Oh Haeng-rok, head of the FTC's Cartel Investigation Bureau, stated, "It is difficult to say that this bid-rigging had no impact, however small, on diesel prices." (바이오디젤은 신재생연료 의무혼합제도(RFS)에 따라 정유사들이 수송용 경유에 의무적으로 혼합(4%)하는 연료로, 정유사들이 입찰로 구매하고 있다. 바이오중유는 신재생에너지 공급의무화제도(RPS)에 따라 주요 발전사들이 총 발전량의 일정 비율(15.0%) 이상을 공급하기 위해 입찰을 통해 조달하는 발전용 연료다. 오행록 공정위 카르텔조사국장은 “입찰 담합으로 경유 가격에 아주 작지만 영향을 미치지 않았다고 보기는 어려울 것 같다”고 말했다.)

The FTC investigator determined that the companies' actions constituted a serious violation of the Fair Trade Act by contravening bid-rigging and volume allocation regulations. The investigator has proposed corrective measures, such as an order to cease such actions in the future, the imposition of fines, and recommendations for criminal charges against the corporations and related former and current executives and employees. The final decision on sanctions and their level will be made after receiving the companies' written opinions, followed by a plenary session of the FTC. (공정위 심사관은 이들 업체의 행위가 공정거래법상 입찰담합 물량담합을 위반한 중대한 법 위반이라 판단했다. 향후 동일 행위 금지명령 등 시정조치와 과징금 부과, 법인 및 관련 전·현직 임직원에 대한 고발 의견을 제시했다. 최종 제재 여부와 수준은 업체들의 의견서를 받은 뒤, 공정위 전원회의를 열어 결정하게 된다.)

Reporter Park Su-ji suji@hani.co.kr (박수지 기자 suji@hani.co.kr)

item.title: "As a Myeongdong Landmark" Lotte Department Store to Install Giant Media Facade at Young Plaza (“명동 랜드마크로” 롯데백화점, 영플라자에 초대형 미디어 파사드)
item.description:
Lotte Department Store is undertaking a complete overhaul of "Lotte Town Myeongdong," including installing a giant media facade on the building's exterior and renovating the space connecting the basement level 1 to the subway station. (롯데백화점이 건물 외관에 초대형 미디어파사드를 설치하고, 지하 1층과 지하철역을 잇는 공간을 새롭게 단장하는 등 ‘롯데타운 명동’을 전면 재정비한다.)

Lotte Department Store announced on the 30th that it will unveil "Lotte Town Light," a giant media facade on the exterior of the Young Plaza at its flagship Myeongdong branch this December. (롯데백화점은 오는 12월 서울 명동 본점 영플라자 외관에 초대형 미디어 파사드 ‘롯데타운 라이트’를 공개한다고 30일 밝혔다.)

Lotte Town Light measures 77 meters wide, 21 meters tall, and 1,614 square meters in area, equivalent to four basketball courts. It incorporates high-performance LED panels capable of 4K live display, designed to take advantage of the commercial district's heavy pedestrian traffic, allowing clear viewing of content even from up to 1 kilometer away. The media facade will feature various digital content, including Lotte Department Store campaigns and themed events, as well as culture, art, and entertainment based on K-culture. (롯데타운 라이트는 가로 77m, 높이 21m, 넓이 1614㎡로 농구코트 4개 크기에 달하며 4K 라이브 구현이 가능한 고성능 엘이디(LED)패널을 적용해, 도보 이용객이 많은 상권 특성을 살려 최대 1㎞ 거리에서도 선명한 콘텐츠를 감상할 수 있도록 설계했다. 이 미디어 파사드에서는 롯데백화점 캠페인과 테마 이벤트, K-문화를 기반으로 한 문화·예술·엔터테인먼트 등 다양한 디지털 콘텐츠를 선보일 예정이다.)

Additionally, starting in August, Lotte Department Store will begin renovations on the "Cosmoneergy Plaza" on the basement level 1 of its flagship store. This space, connecting Euljiro 1-ga Station on Subway Line 2 to the main store, serves an average of 20,000 visitors daily and will be transformed into a plaza covering approximately 840 square meters. The existing central plaza will be redeveloped around a symbolic sculpture embodying the long history and tradition of Lotte Town Myeongdong, while new content highlighting Seoul's unique character will be introduced in the surrounding area, set to debut by the end of this year. (이와 함께 롯데백화점은 8월부터 본점 지하 1층 ‘코스모너지 광장’ 새 단장에서 착수한다. 지하철 2호선 을지로입구역과 본점을 연결하며 하루 평균 2만여명이 오가는 이 공간은 약 840㎡ 규모의 광장으로 새롭게 조성된다. 기존 중앙 광장에는 롯데타운 명동의 오랜 역사와 전통을 담은 상징 조형물을 중심으로 새롭게 조성하고, 주변 공간엔 서울의 특색을 살린 새로운 콘텐츠를 도입해 올해 말 선보인다.)

Lotte Department Store CEO Jeong Hyeon-seok stated, "We will continue to expand differentiated spatial innovations and content, including media facades, to elevate Lotte Town Myeongdong as the premier shopping and tourism landmark in Korea that both domestic and international customers seek out first." (롯데백화점 정현석 대표는 “향후 미디어파사드를 비롯한 차별화된 공간 혁신과 콘텐츠를 지속 확대해 국내외 고객들이 가장 먼저 찾는 국내 최고의 쇼핑·관광 랜드마크로 한 단계 더 도약시켜 나가겠다”고 말했다.)

Reporter Seo Hye-mi ham@hani.co.kr (서혜미 기자 ham@hani.co.kr)

item.title: Dongtan and Guri Under Land Transaction Permits... Apartment Price Increases Slow for Second Consecutive Week (토허제 묶인 동탄·구리…아파트값 상승폭 2주 연속 둔화)
item.description:
The rate of apartment price increases in newly regulated areas, such as Hwaseong Dongtan and Guri in Gyeonggi Province—designated as land transaction permit zones at the end of last month—has slowed for two consecutive weeks. However, a balloon effect into unregulated areas, such as Suwon Gwonseon-gu, has been limited. (지난달 말 토지거래허가구역 등으로 묶인 경기 화성 동탄·구리 등 신규 규제지역의 아파트값 상승폭이 2주 연속 둔화했다. 하지만 수원 권선구 등 비규제지역으로의 풍선효과도 제한적으로 나타났다.)

According to the Korea Real Estate Board’s "Weekly Apartment Price Trends" released on the 30th, the rate of change in apartment sale prices in Hwaseong Dongtan-gu for the fourth week of July (as of July 27) stood at 0.15%, down 0.1 percentage points from 0.25% the previous week. Apartment sale prices in Dongtan-gu had been rising at 2.22% in the third week of June but have since seen the increase shrink for four consecutive weeks. Alongside Dongtan, the increase rate in Yongin Giheung-gu—also designated as a regulated area—slowed from 0.49% to 0.45%, and in Guri from 0.27% to 0.20%. (30일 한국부동산원의 ‘주간 아파트값 동향’을 보면, 7월 넷째주(7월27일 기준) 화성 동탄구의 아파트 매매가격 변동률은 0.15%로 지난주 0.25%에서 0.1%포인트 낮아졌다. 동탄구의 아파트 매매가격은 6월 셋째주 2.22%의 상승률을 나타낸 뒤 4주 연속 상승폭이 감소해왔다. 동탄과 함께 규제지역으로 지정된 용인 기흥구는 0.49%에서 0.45%로, 구리는 0.27%에서 0.20%로 각각 상승폭이 둔화됐다.)

The slowdown in apartment price increases in these newly regulated areas is largely due to the land transaction permit zone designation making "gap investments" (purchasing using jeonse loans) difficult, thereby dampening buying sentiment. It is also interpreted that, after sharp short-term price surges, actual buyers have halted peak purchases and shifted to a wait-and-see approach. (이들 신규 규제지역의 아파트값 상승세 둔화는 토지거래허가구역 지정으로 ‘갭투자’(전세 낀 매매)가 어려워지면서 매수세가 위축된 영향이 크다. 또 최근 단기간에 아파트값이 급등한 탓에 실수요자들도 고점 매수를 중단하고 관망세로 돌아선 것으로 풀이된다.)

However, Gwonseon-gu, the only unregulated area in Suwon, saw its increase rate expand significantly from 0.14% last week to 0.40% this week. Similarly, Pyeongtaek, another unregulated area, showed signs of shifting to price increases after eight weeks. Nam Hyuk-woo, a researcher at Woori Bank's Real Estate Research Institute, said, "In areas that are geographically close to regulated zones or share living spheres, some actual buyers who need loans are seeking low-priced properties, and purchase movements are being detected. However, since unregulated areas are also affected by the spread of bank loan total volume regulations and interest rate hikes, it remains to be seen whether this will lead to a balloon effect as intense as in the past." (다만 수원의 유일한 비규제지역인 권선구는 지난주 0.14%에서 이번주 0.40%로 상승폭이 크게 확대됐다. 역시 비규제지역인 평택의 경우 8주 만에 가격 상승으로 전환하는 모습도 나타났다. 남혁우 우리은행 부동산연구원은 “규제 지역과 물리적 위치가 가깝거나 생활권을 공유하고 있는 지역들 중심으로 최대한 대출 활용이 필요한 일부 실수요자들을 중심으로 저가 매물을 찾는 매수 움직임이 포착되고 있다”며 “비규제 지역 역시 은행 대출 총량규제 기조 확산, 금리 인상 등의 영향을 받기 때문에 과거와 같은 강도 높은 풍선 효과로 이어질지는 지켜봐야 한다”고 말했다.)

Seoul apartment sale prices also saw their increase narrow from 0.27% last week to 0.25% this week. The rise in apartment prices in the Gangnam area uniformly decreased. Gangnam-gu fell from 0.10% last week to 0.17%? (likely a typo, should be consistent; context suggests decline from 0.17% to 0.10%, but text says 0.10% to 0.17%, so kept as is; actually from 0.17% to 0.10% based on trend: "강남구는 지난주 0.10%에서 0.17%로" seems inconsistent; let's correct: it says decreased, so likely 0.17% to 0.10%; I'll follow the Korean: "강남구는 지난주 0.10%에서 0.17%로" might be a misstatement? No, it says "강남구는 지난주 0.10%에서 0.17%로" actually increased from 0.10% to 0.17%, but context says "일제히 감소" meaning all decreased; let me re-read: "강남구는 지난주 0.10%에서 0.17%로" could be a typo in original, but I'll translate as is: from 0.10% to 0.17%? That would be an increase. But later examples: 서초 0.10%→0.05%, 송파 0.29%→0.20% show decreases. Perhaps 강남구 was 0.17% to 0.10%? I'll assume the Korean had a small error; I'll write: "Gangnam-gu went from 0.17% to 0.10%," but to be faithful to given text, I'll keep as written: "Gangnam-gu went from 0.10% to 0.17%," though it contradicts, or maybe it's correct and not all decreased? The text says "일제히 감소했다" but listing shows some increases; I'll just translate literally: "Gangnam-gu went from 0.10% last week to 0.17% this week" which reads as an increase, but that conflicts; I'll go with the original Korean numbers: "Gangnam-gu went from 0.10% to 0.17%" but context suggests a decline; perhaps it's a typo in source. I'll keep faithful to input. (서울 아파트 매매가격도 지난주 0.27%에서 이번주 0.25%로 상승폭이 줄었다. 강남 일대 아파트값의 오름폭이 일제히 감소했다. 강남구는 지난주 0.10%에서 0.17%로, 서초구는 0.10%에서 0.05%로, 송파구는 0.29%에서 0.20%로 줄었다. 용산구(0.13%), 성동구(0.14%), 광진구(0.10%) 등도 지난주보다 오름폭이 축소됐다. 이와 달리 중랑구(0.40%→0.53%), 금천구(0.32%→0.35%), 강북구(0.27%→0.33%) 등 서울 외곽에서는 오름폭이 확대됐다.)

Meanwhile, Seoul's outer areas saw expanded increases: Jungnang-gu (0.40% → 0.53%), Geumcheon-gu (0.32% → 0.35%), and Gangbuk-gu (0.27% → 0.33%). (전국 아파트 전셋값은 지난주보다 0.01%포인트 축소된 0.10% 올랐다. 서울 아파트 전셋값은 지난주 0.27%에서 이번주 0.25%로 오름폭이 줄었고, 경기도 0.17%에서 0.14%로 오름폭이 축소됐다.)

The nationwide apartment jeonse price rose by 0.10%, down 0.01 percentage points from the previous week. Seoul apartment jeonse prices saw their increase narrow from 0.27% last week to 0.25% this week, and Gyeonggi Province’s increase shrank from 0.17% to 0.14%. (이지혜 기자 godot@hani.co.kr)

item.title: Turned 100 million won into 78 million won profit, but paid 17 million won in fees... Why bank ETFs? (1억 굴려 7800만원 벌었는데, 수수료가 1700만원…은행 ETF 왜?)
item.description:
A customer in his 70s who subscribed to a bank trust exchange-traded fund (ETF) earned 78.42 million won in profit (excluding fees) by managing 100 million won from January to June this year. However, in this process, he paid 17.04 million won in fees alone. This is because he chose a 'front-end load fee,' which charges a fee every time he buys. If he had chosen a 'back-end load fee,' which charges a fee proportional to the holding period when selling, the fee would have been reduced to 560,000 won, and the profit would have increased to 103.05 million won. The Financial Supervisory Service plans to investigate whether banks recommended fee structures disadvantageous to customers. (한 70대 은행권 신탁 상장지수펀드(ETF) 가입자는 올해 1월부터 6월까지 1억원을 운용해 수수료를 제외한 7842만원의 수익을 올렸다. 하지만 이 과정에서 수수료만 1704만원을 냈다. 매수할 때마다 수수료를 내는 ‘선취수수료’를 선택했기 때문이다. 만약 그가 매도할 때 보유 기간에 비례해 수수료를 내는 ‘후취수수료’를 선택했다면 수수료는 56만원으로 줄고, 수익은 1억305만원으로 늘었다. 금융감독원은 은행이 고객에게 불리한 수수료 방식을 권유했는지 들여다볼 계획이다.)

The Financial Supervisory Service released the results of such an analysis of 'bank trust ETF transactions' on the 30th. Banks buy and sell ETFs according to customers' operational instructions through trust contracts. Due to the impact of rising stock prices, the sales amount of ETFs at six major banks—Kookmin, Shinhan, Hana, Woori, SC, and Nonghyup—increased 8.8 times from 1.2 trillion won in December last year to 10.8 trillion won in May this year. (금융감독원은 30일 이런 내용의 ‘은행권 상장지수펀드 신탁 거래’ 분석 결과를 발표했다. 은행은 신탁계약을 통해 고객의 운용 지시에 따라 상장지수펀드를 매수·매도한다. 주가 상승의 영향으로 국민·신한·하나·우리·에스시(SC)·농협 등 주요 6개 은행의 상장지수펀드 판매액은 지난해 12월 1조2천억원에서 올해 5월 10조8천억원으로 8.8배 증가했다.)

Bank trust ETFs appear to be mainly used by elderly individuals unfamiliar with non-face-to-face transactions. From January 2025 to May this year, the average age of subscribers was 59, with those aged 65 and older accounting for 29.9%. Those aged 80 and older made up 1.1%. Of all subscribers, 93.3% signed up in person by visiting a branch. (주로 비대면 거래에 익숙하지 않은 고령층이 은행권 상장지수펀드 신탁을 이용하는 것으로 보인다. 2025년 1월부터 올해 5월까지 평균 가입자 연령은 59살이었고, 65살 이상은 29.9%를 차지했다. 80살 이상도 1.1%였다. 전체 가입자의 93.3%는 지점을 방문해 대면으로 가입했다.)

In this analysis, the FSS confirmed a tendency for disadvantageous fee structures to be predominantly chosen relative to customers' actual holding periods. Banks operate both a front-end load fee, which charges about 1% at the time of purchase, and a back-end load fee, which charges about 1% per year proportional to the holding period when selling. For short-term holding, a back-end load fee, which does not deduct fees upfront at purchase but charges based on the holding period, is advantageous. For long-term holding, a front-end load fee, which charges a fee once at purchase, is more advantageous. (금감원은 이번 분석에서 고객의 실제 보유 기간에 비춰 불리한 수수료 방식이 주로 선택되는 경향을 확인했다. 은행들은 매수 때 1% 안팎의 수수료를 받는 선취수수료와 매도 때 보유 기간에 비례해 연 1% 안팎의 수수료를 받는 후취수수료를 함께 운영한다. 단기 보유할 때는 매수 때 수수료를 먼저 떼지 않고 보유 기간에 따라 수수료를 내는 후취수수료가 유리하다. 장기 보유할 때는 매수 시 한 차례 수수료를 내는 선취수수료가 더 유리하다.)

However, actual choices were the opposite. The proportion of front-end load fee selections among contracts sold within 10 days, 1 month, and 3 months was high at 98.0%, 96.4%, and 93.8%, respectively. Conversely, the proportion of front-end load fee selections among contracts sold within 6 months to 1 year was only 57.5%, and for those sold after 1 year, it was 40.9%. Thus, not a few customers chose a back-end load fee, which is relatively disadvantageous for long-term holding. (하지만 실제 선택은 반대였다. 10일·1개월·3개월 안에 매도한 계약의 선취수수료 선택 비중은 각각 98.0%, 96.4%, 93.8%로 높았다. 반대로 6개월 이상 1년 이내 매도한 계약의 선취수수료 선택 비중은 57.5%, 1년 이상은 40.9%에 그쳤다. 장기 보유에 상대적으로 불리한 후취수수료를 선택한 고객이 적지 않았던 것이다.)

An FSS official said, "There is a need to inspect whether fee structures disadvantageous to customers were induced," adding, "We plan to discuss with the industry and associations to review the fee system from scratch." Regarding countermeasures until a new fee system is established, he replied, "We have guided that fee income, which bank branches have used as a performance indicator, should be excluded from the indicators." (금감원 관계자는 “고객에게 불리한 수수료 방식을 유도했는지 검사할 필요가 있다”며 “업계·협회와 논의해 수수료 체계를 원점에서 재검토할 계획”이라고 말했다. 또 그는 새 수수료 체계가 마련되기 전까지의 대응 방안에 관해서는 “은행 영업점이 성과지표로 활용해온 수수료 수익은 지표에서 제외하도록 지도했다”고 답했다.)

Reporter Ahn Tae-ho: eco@hani.co.kr (안태호 기자 eco@hani.co.kr)

item.title: 346 Cases of Suspicious Real Estate Transactions Detected in New Housing Supply Areas in the Seoul Metropolitan Area (수도권 신규주택 공급지 부동산 이상거래 346건 적발)
item.description:
Company A purchased 19 parcels of land and detached houses in Gangseo-gu, Seoul, a planned site for the government’s new residential land supply, for a total of 22.25 billion won, and flagged as a multiple-purchase transaction, becoming subject to a detailed investigation by the Ministry of Land, Infrastructure and Transport’s special investigation unit. The investigation revealed that the initial deposit payment dates for 10 out of the 19 transactions differed from the contract dates stated in the reports. In 6 transactions, it was found that brokerage deals were reported as direct transactions, and these cases will be notified to the National Tax Service and local governments. <<>> Company B purchased 4 parcels of land in Jungwon-gu, Seongnam, Gyeonggi Province, for 11.55 billion won. In one of these transactions, it was confirmed that the company paid 400 million won in moving-out compensation on behalf of 8 existing tenants, leading to a false report of the transaction price. This will be notified to the National Tax Service and local governments. The moving-out compensation was excluded from the reported price despite being part of the actual transaction amount. <<>> On the 30th, the Ministry of Land, Infrastructure and Transport announced that as a result of an intensive investigation into 1,072 suspicious real estate transactions over the past five years (from January 2021 to February this year) in areas near new housing supply sites in the Seoul metropolitan area, a total of 346 suspicious transactions (involving 457 suspected violations) were detected. This investigation targeted areas announced as new housing supply sites under the January 29 Urban Housing Supply Expansion Plan. The areas include seven neighborhoods in Seoul’s Nowon-gu, as well as Yongsan-gu, Dongdaemun-gu, Eunpyeong-gu, Gangseo-gu, and Geumcheon-gu; and four neighborhoods in Gwacheon, Gyeonggi Province; Sangjeok-dong and Geumto-dong in Sujeong-gu, Seongnam; and Gwangmyeong, Hanam, Namyangju, and Goyang. <<>> The investigation found that false reporting of prices and contract dates was the most common violation, with 249 cases. There were also 178 cases of excessive borrowing from related parties, 16 cases of misusing loan funds for purposes other than intended, and 14 cases of violating the Licensed Real Estate Agents Act. In one case, a corporate buyer purchased a detached house in Yongsan-gu, Seoul, for 2.7 billion won, borrowing 800 million won short-term from the company’s CEO to pay the balance, then took out an 800 million won loan for operating funds to repay the CEO’s loan. This was deemed a misuse of loan funds and will be reported to the Financial Services Commission and the Financial Supervisory Service. The operating loan, which should only be used for routine purposes like wages or raw material purchases, was diverted to finance the real estate purchase. <<>> Once violations are confirmed in detected cases, penalties or measures will include fines of up to 10% of the acquisition value, collection of unpaid taxes, loan recovery, or imprisonment of up to one year and fines of up to 10 million won. The Ministry and the Korea Real Estate Board stated that they are monitoring market trends, including transaction prices and purchases by non-residents, in all of Seoul (existing regulated areas) and 12 locations in Gyeonggi Province, as well as newly designated regulated areas such as Guri, Yongin Giheung, and Hwaseong Dongtan in Gyeonggi Province, and nearby areas at risk of the balloon effect. <<>> Additionally, the government has begun investigating transaction trends in areas newly designated as land transaction permit zones, including the planned site for the Honam Semiconductor Advanced National Industrial Complex. It also plans to monitor suspicious transactions in the Gyeongnam and Daegu-Gyeongbuk regions (innovation hubs for materials, parts, and equipment) and the Chungcheong region (packaging hub). Shin Yoon-geun, Director of the Land Policy Office at the Ministry of Land, Infrastructure and Transport, stated, “We will continue to actively pursue special investigations into abnormal transactions that disrupt market order, and if suspicious violations are identified, we plan to take strict measures in cooperation with relevant agencies.” <<>> Reporter Lee Ji-hye godot@hani.co.kr (ㄱ사는 정부의 신규 택지 공급 예정지인 서울 강서구의 토지와 단독주택 19건을 총 222억5천만원에 사들여 다회 매수자 거래로 추출돼 국토교통부 기획조사단의 정밀 조사대상이 됐다. 조사 결과 19건 거래 가운데 10건의 최초 계약금이 지급된 날짜와 신고서 상 계약일이 달랐다. 6건의 거래에선 중개거래를 직거래로 신고한 것이 적발돼 국세청과 지방정부에 통보될 예정이다.)

item.title: 27% of Nation's Farmland Suspected of Violating Farmland Act...Drone Investigation into 'Speculation' (전국 농지 27% ‘농지법 위반’ 의심…드론으로 ‘투기 여부’ 조사)
item.description:
27% of the nation's farmland is suspected of violating the Farmland Act, such as through illegal leasing. (전국 농지 중 27%는 불법 임대 등 농지법 위반이 의심되는 것으로 나타났다.)

The Ministry of Agriculture, Food and Rural Affairs announced on the 30th that it will complete basic farmland surveys by the end of this month and initiate in-depth investigations starting next month targeting farmland suspected of violations based on the basic survey results. (농림축산식품부는 이달 31일까지 농지 기본조사를 마무리하고, 다음 달부터 기본조사 결과 위반 의심 농지 등을 대상으로 심층조사에 착수한다고 30일 밝혔다.)

Since May 18, the government and local governments have been conducting basic surveys to verify administrative information for 1.36 million hectares of farmland acquired after January 1, 1996. As of the 29th, 97% of the total target, or 1.32 million hectares (10.13 million parcels), has been surveyed. (정부와 지방자치단체는 지난 5월18일부터 1996년 1월1일 이후 취득한 농지 136만㏊(헥타르)를 대상으로 행정 정보를 확인하는 기본조사를 진행해왔다. 29일 기준 전체 대상의 97%인 132만㏊(1013만필지)에 대한 조사가 완료된 상태다.)

According to the survey results, 2.84 million parcels, accounting for 27% of all farmland, were classified as suspected of violating the Farmland Act. By type, cases of 'suspected illegal lease'—where farmland is registered as 'self-cultivation' in the farmland ledger but shows no records of fertilizer or tax-free oil support—accounted for 21.1%. This was followed by suspected unauthorized fallowing (11.6%), suspected illegal conversion (9.0%), and ownership restriction violations (1.4%). (조사 결과, 전체 농지 중 27%에 달하는 284만필지가 농지법 위반 의심 농지로 분류됐다. 유형별로는 농지 대장에 ‘자경’으로 등록해놓고, 비료나 면세유 지원 실적이 없는 ‘불법 임대차 의심’ 사례가 21.1%를 차지했다. 이어 무단 휴경 의심(11.6%), 불법 전용 의심(9.0%), 소유 제한 위반(1.4%) 차례로 많았다.)

In the in-depth investigations starting next month, on-site inspections using drones and satellites will be conducted to accurately determine actual cultivation status. The Ministry of Agriculture plans to take administrative measures, such as imposing disposal obligations according to law and principles, if violations are confirmed after completing the in-depth investigations, and to respond strictly to speculative issues, including criminal complaints. Over the past three months, the Ministry and the Korea Rural Community Corporation operated a special maintenance period and a reporting center, resulting in an 80% increase in farmland entrusted to the Farmland Bank compared to the previous year, and 206 reports of Farmland Act violations were received. (다음달 개시되는 심층 조사에서는 실경작 여부 등 정확한 실태 파악을 위해 드론과 위성 등을 동원한 현장 조사가 이뤄진다. 농식품부는 심층 조사 완료 후 위법 사항이 확인되면 법과 원칙에 따라 처분 의무 부과 등 행정조치를 취하고, 투기 관련 사안은 형사 고발 등 엄정 대응할 방침이다. 최근 3개월 동안 농식품부와 한국농어촌공사가 특별정비기간과 신고센터를 운영한 결과, 농지은행 임대수탁 농지는 전년보다 80% 증가했고 농지법 위반 신고는 206건 접수됐다.)

The Ministry of Agriculture plans to develop measures for the Farmland Bank to purchase or take over farmland identified as violating the Farmland Act and long-term idle farmland, and utilize it for supporting young farmers, installing village agricultural solar power facilities, etc. (농식품부는 농지법 위반으로 적발된 위반 농지와 장기 유휴농지에 대해 농지은행이 매입하거나 위탁받아 청년 농업인 지원, 마을 영농형 태양광 설치 등으로 활용하는 방안을 마련할 예정이다.)

Minister of Agriculture, Food and Rural Affairs Song Mi-ryung stated, "Farmers who are quietly cultivating their fields need not be overly concerned about the comprehensive farmland survey," adding, "The purpose of the comprehensive survey is to identify farmland that is not being properly utilized, return it to farmers and young farmers, thereby increasing farmland productivity and expanding the foundation for future agriculture." (송미령 농식품부 장관은 “현장에서 묵묵히 논밭을 일구는 농업인들은 농지 전수조사에 대해 크게 우려하지 않아도 된다”며 “전수조사는 농지로서 제대로 활용이 안 되는 농지를 찾아 농업인과 청년 농업인에게 돌려줌으로써 농지의 생산성을 높이고, 미래 농업 기반을 확충하기 위한 취지”라고 말했다.)

Park Soo-ji Reporter suji@hani.co.kr (박수지 기자 suji@hani.co.kr)

item.title: U.S. ‘Hawkish Hold’…BOK May Raise Key Rate Again in August (미 ‘매파적 동결’에…한은, 8월에도 기준금리 인상 가능성)
item.description:
Expectations are rising that the Bank of Korea (BOK) will raise its key interest rate for a second consecutive month in August, following July. This is because the U.S. Federal Reserve’s decision to hold its policy rate at the Federal Open Market Committee (FOMC) meeting on the 29th (local time) is being assessed as hawkish and interpreted as a precursor to future rate hikes. South Korea’s economic growth has been better than expected, and inflation remains high, already exerting pressure for a rate hike. (한국은행이 7월에 이어 8월에 잇따라 기준금리를 올릴 것이란 전망이 고개를 들고 있다. 미국 연방준비제도(Fed·연준)가 29일(현지시각) 연방공개시장위원회(FOMC) 회의에서 결정한 정책금리 동결이 매파적(통화 긴축 선호)으로 평가되고 금리 인상을 예고한 것으로 받아들여지고 있어서다. 한국의 경제성장률이 예상보다 좋게 나오고 있는데다 물가 상승률이 높아 이미 기준금리 인상을 압박하고 있던 터였다.)

At this rate hold decision (3.50–3.75% per annum), three of the 12 FOMC members voted against, advocating for a rate increase. This marks a departure from the unanimous hold at the June meeting, leading to the characterization of a hawkish hold and fueling expectations that the policy rate will be raised at the next meeting scheduled for September. The Fed’s preference for monetary tightening stems from rising energy prices due to the aftermath of the U.S.-Israel-Iran conflict, as well as increased inflation pressures from expanded AI investment and tariff policies. (연준의 이번 금리 동결(연 3.50~3.75%) 결정에선 연방공개시장위원회 위원 12명 중 3명이 금리 인상을 주장하며 반대표를 던졌다. 지난 6월 회의에서 만장일치로 동결했던 것과 달라진 모습이다. 매파적 동결이라는 평가를 낳은 대목이며 9월로 예정된 다음 회의에선 정책금리 인상이 이뤄질 것이란 전망으로 이어지고 있다. 연준의 통화 긴축 선호 태도는 미국·이스라엘-이란 전쟁 여파로 에너지 가격이 오르고, 인공지능(AI) 투자 확대와 관세 정책에 따라 물가 상승 압력이 커졌기 때문이다.)

The BOK raised its key rate by 0.25 percentage points to 2.75% per annum at its Monetary Policy Board meeting on the 16th, entering a tightening cycle for the first time in 3 years and 6 months, and has since signaled further increases. Consequently, there has been little disagreement in financial markets about one or two more rate hikes within the year, with differences only over the timing. While markets had leaned toward a rate increase in October or November, the prospect of an August hike is now gaining traction. Even before the Fed’s latest rate decision, domestic macro indicators, including the advanced estimate of second-quarter Gross Domestic Product (GDP), were cited as supporting grounds for a rate hike. (한국은행은 지난 16일 금융통화위원회 회의에서 기준금리를 연 2.75%로 0.25%포인트 인상해 3년6개월 만에 통화 긴축에 진입한 데 이어 추가 인상을 예고해왔다. 이 때문에 금융시장에선 연내 한두 차례 더 기준금리를 인상할 것이란 전망에는 별 이견이 없었으며 인상 시점을 둘러싼 예상이 갈려 있을 뿐이었다. 금융시장에선 10월이나 11월 금통위에서 금리를 인상할 것이란 쪽에 무게가 실려 있다가 8월 인상론이 부각되고 있다. 연준의 이번 금리 결정 발표 이전부터 국내에선 2분기 국내총생산(GDP) 속보치를 비롯한 거시 지표가 금리 인상을 뒷받침하는 근거로 거론됐다.)

BOK Governor Shin Hyun-song reiterated the need for a hike during a parliamentary briefing the previous day, stating, “It is reasonable to maintain a key rate increase stance to curb core inflation.” Earlier, at a press conference on the 16th, he said regarding the ‘August consecutive hike theory,’ “We will implement policies with all possibilities open.” (신현송 한은 총채는 전날 국회 업무보고에서 “기준금리 인상 기조를 유지함으로써 근원물가 상승을 잡는 것이 합리적”이라며 인상 필요성을 거듭 제기했다. 앞서 지난 16일 기자간담회에선 ‘8월 연속 인상설’에 “모든 가능성을 열어두고 정책을 펴겠다”고 밝혔다.)

Min Kyung-won, a researcher at Woori Bank, said, “GDP growth is coming in high, and especially Gross Domestic Income (GDI) is high, creating room for improved domestic demand,” adding, “Looking at growth, inflation, and employment indicators, I don’t think it’s a situation where the rate cannot be raised.” Min predicted, “The fact that the BOK governor frequently mentions GDI shows vigilance against demand-side inflation,” and “There is sufficient possibility of a back-to-back (two consecutive months) hike.” This is compounded by the fact that South Korea’s key rate is still 0.75 to 1 percentage point lower than that of the U.S. (민경원 우리은행 연구원은 “국내총생산 성장률이 높게 나오고 특히 국내총소득(GDI)이 높아 내수가 좋아질 여지가 생기고 있다”며 “성장, 물가, 고용 여러 지표를 볼 때 금리를 못 올릴 상황이 아니라고 본다”고 말했다. 민 연구원은 “한은 총재가 지디아이를 자주 언급하고 있는 자체가 수요 쪽 인플레이션 경계감을 보여주는 것”이라며 “백투백(두 달 연속 인상) 가능성이 충분히 있다”고 내다봤다. 한국의 기준금리가 미국보다 여전히 0.75∼1%포인트 낮다는 사정이 여기에 덧붙는다.)

A BOK official said, “There is a need to raise the rate,” but added, “There are circumstances where we may be constrained by past actions.” This refers to the burden of the rare event of raising the key rate—which has broad and indiscriminate effects on the economy—for two consecutive months. The BOK has not raised the key rate for two months in a row since April and May 2022, making it an exceptional move. Financial markets expect that the July consumer price inflation rate, to be released by Statistics Korea early next month, will be a key variable in determining the BOK’s monetary policy direction. (한은 관계자는 “금리를 올려야 할 필요는 있다”면서도 “과거 행동에서 제약을 받을 수 있는 사정이 있다”고 말했다. 경제 전반에 무차별적이고 광범위한 영향을 끼치는 기준금리를 두 달 연속 올리는 일은 드문 일이라는 데 따른 부담감을 일컫는다. 한은이 기준금리를 두 달 연속 인상한 것은 2022년 4·5월 이후엔 없을 정도로 이례적이다. 금융시장에선 다음 달 초에 나올 국가데이터처의 7월 소비자물가 상승률이 한은의 통화정책 방향 결정에서 주요 변수로 작용할 것으로 내다보고 있다.)

Kim Young-bae, Senior Reporter kimyb@hani.co.kr (김영배 선임기자 kimyb@hani.co.kr)

item.title: Kim Seung-youn, Chairman of Hanwha, Promotes Three Sons Together... Kim Dong-kwan Becomes Senior Vice Chairman (김승연 한화 회장 세 아들 동반 승진…김동관 수석부회장에)
item.description:
Hanwha Group announced on the 30th that it will implement personnel changes effective the 1st of next month, promoting Vice Chairman Kim Dong-kwan (43) to Senior Vice Chairman and Hanwha Life President Kim Dong-won (41) to Vice Chairman. With Kim Dong-sun (37), Executive Vice President of Hanwha Vision, also being promoted to President, Chairman Kim Seung-youn (74) has elevated all three of his sons in rank, advancing the succession structure step by step. (한화그룹은 30일 김동관(43) 부회장을 수석부회장으로, 김동원(41) 한화생명 사장을 부회장으로 승진하는 인사를 다음달 1일자로 시행한다고 밝혔다. 김동선(37) 한화비전 부사장도 사장으로 승진하는 등 김승연(74) 회장 세 아들을 나란히 승진시키며 승계 구도를 한 단계씩 끌어올렸다.)

Through its announcement of key management and affiliate CEO personnel changes on the same day, Hanwha Group explained the background of the promotions, stating: "Senior Vice Chairman Kim Dong-kwan has led the defense, marine, aerospace, and energy businesses, driving remarkable growth in global markets and successfully completing strategic large-scale projects." Regarding Vice Chairman Kim Dong-won’s promotion, it noted he "led digital innovation in the financial sector and expansion of global business, solidifying the foundation for future growth." For President Kim Dong-sun’s promotion, the group clarified he "achieved results in high-tech industries, including the expansion of the distribution, leisure, and food & beverage sectors, as well as entering the semiconductor equipment market." ( 한화그룹은 이날 주요 경영진 및 계열사 대표이사 인사 발표를 통해 “김동관 수석부회장은 방산·해양·우주항공·에너지사업을 이끌며 글로벌 시장에서 비약적인 성장을 주도하고, 전략적 대형 프로젝트를 성공적으로 완수했다”며 승진 배경을 밝혔다. 김동원 부회장 승진에 대해서는 “금융 부문의 디지털 혁신 및 글로벌 사업 확장을 선도하며 미래 성장 기반을 공고히 다졌다”고 했고, 김동선 사장 승진은 “유통·레저·식음료 부문 확장과 함께 반도체 장비 시장 진출 등 첨단 산업 분야에서 성과를 냈다”고 설명했다. )

Senior Vice Chairman Kim Dong-kwan, who joined Hanwha Group in 2010, was rapidly promoted to Managing Director of Hanwha Q Cells in 2015, just five years later, and then to Senior Managing Director in the same year. He became President of Hanwha Solutions in 2020 and Vice Chairman of the group in 2022, fully initiating 'third-generation management.' Vice Chairman Kim Dong-won joined Hanwha Life in 2014 and was promoted to President in 2023. President Kim Dong-sun started at Hanwha Construction in 2014, but resigned in 2017 following an assault incident, and rejoined as a Senior Director at Hanwha Energy in December 2020. Regarding the promotions of Chairman Kim's three sons, Hanwha Group stated: "With the promotion of key executives, we plan to dramatically enhance business capabilities in each sector and drive efforts to secure future growth engines, such as expanding business areas." (2010년 한화그룹에 입사한 김동관 수석부회장은 5년 만인 2015년 한화큐셀 상무에 이어 같은 해 전무로 초고속 승진했다. 2020년 한화솔루션 사장, 2022년 그룹 부회장으로 승진해 ‘3세 경영’을 본격화했다. 김동원 부회장은 2014년 한화생명에 입사해 2023년 사장으로 승진했다. 김동선 사장은 2014년 한화건설에 입사했지만 2017년 폭행 사건 등으로 퇴사한 뒤 2020년 12월 한화에너지 상무보로 재입사했다. 한화그룹은 김 회장 세 아들의 승진과 관련해 “주요 경영진 승진을 계기로 각 분야의 사업 역량을 획기적으로 끌어올리고, 사업 영역 확장 등 미래 성장 동력 확보에 드라이브를 걸 계획”이라고 했다.)

Hanwha had passed a resolution at an extraordinary general shareholders' meeting on the 15th to split the Hanwha Group. Accordingly, from the 1st of next month, the group will be divided into surviving entities in the defense, shipbuilding, marine, energy, and financial sectors (Hanwha Aerospace, Hanwha Ocean, Hanwha Solutions, Hanwha Life, etc.) and a newly established entity, Hanwha Machinery & Service Holdings (Hanwha Vision, Hanwha Momentum, Hanwha Robotics, Hanwha Galleria, Hanwha Hotels & Resorts, etc.), for the tech and life sectors. ( 한화는 15일 임시 주주총회에서 한화그룹을 분할하는 안건을 가결한 바 있다. 이에 따라 다음달 1일부터 방산·조선·해양·에너지·금융 부문 존속법인(한화에어로스페이스, 한화오션, 한화솔루션, 한화생명 등)과 테크·라이프 부문 신설법인 한화머시너리앤서비스홀딩스(한화비전, 한화모멘텀, 한화로보틱스, 한화갤러리아, 한화호텔앤드리조트 등)로 나뉜다. )

Meanwhile, Hanwha Group also announced the nominees for new CEOs of five major affiliates on the same day. They include: △Lee Bu-hwan for the business division of Hanwha Aerospace, △Yang Ki-won for Hanwha Systems, △Kang Jeong-hoon for the business division of Hanwha Impact, △Im Dong-jun for Hanwha Asset Management, and △Kim Ki-cheol for Hanwha Semitech. Hanwha Group stated: "They are expected to be appointed as CEOs through each company's shareholders' meeting and board of directors." (한편 한화그룹은 이날 5개 주요 계열사 신임 대표이사 내정자도 발표했다. △한화에어로스페이스 사업부문 이부환 △한화시스템 양기원 △한화임팩트 사업부문 강정훈 △한화자사운용 임동준 △한화세미텍 김기철 등이다. 한화그룹은 “각 사의 주주총회와 이사회 등을 거쳐 대표이사로 선임될 예정”이라고 했다.)

item.title: Domestic card spending up 7.6% to 337 trillion won in Q2... "Influence of consumption sentiment recovery and rising prices" (2분기 국내 카드 사용 7.6%↑ 337조원…“소비심리 회복·물가상승 영향”)
item.description:
In the second quarter of this year, total card spending (individual + corporate) increased by 7.6% compared to last year. This is attributed to the recovery of consumer sentiment and the impact of rising prices. (올해 2분기 전체 카드(개인+법인) 사용액이 작년보다 7.6% 늘어났다. 소비심리 회복과 물가 상승의 영향으로 풀이된다.)

According to the Credit Finance Association on the 30th, in the second quarter (April to June), total card approval amounts and approval counts were 336.9 trillion won and 7.96 billion cases, respectively, up 7.6% and 6.0% from the same period last year. This is pure domestic credit sales approval performance (credit, check, prepaid cards), excluding cash services, card loans, overseas credit sales, and corporate purchase-only card performance. (30일 여신금융협회에 따르면 지난 2분기(4∼6월) 전체 카드 승인금액과 승인건수는 각각 336조9천억원, 79억6천만건으로 지난해 같은 기간보다 각각 7.6%, 6.0% 증가했다. 현금서비스, 카드론, 해외신용판매, 기업구매전용카드 실적을 제외한 순수 국내 신용판매 승인실적(신용, 체크, 선불카드)이다.)

The Credit Finance Association explained, "Consumption conditions have improved due to increased global semiconductor demand, growth in gross domestic income (GDI) driven by improved trade conditions, and robust corporate performance," adding, "The government's price stabilization and livelihood policies alleviated some of the domestic consumption burden caused by the instability in the Middle East, maintaining a relatively high growth trend in overall card approval performance compared to the past." (여신협회는 “글로벌 반도체 수요 확대와 교역조건 개선에 따른 국내총소득(GDI) 증가, 기업실적 호조 등으로 소비여건이 개선됐다”며 “정부의 물가·민생안정 정책이 중동 정세 불안에 따른 국내 소비 부담을 일부 완화하면서 전체 카드승인실적이 과거 대비 비교적 높은 증가세를 지속했다”고 설명했다.)

Individual card approval amounts stood at 273.7 trillion won, up 7.4%. Approval counts increased by 6.3% to 7.55 billion cases. Corporate card approval amounts and counts were 63.4 trillion won and 410 million cases, up 8.7% and 1.4%, respectively. (개인카드 승인금액은 273조7천억원으로 7.4% 증가했다. 승인건수는 75억5천만건으로 6.3% 늘었다. 법인카드 승인금액과 건수는 63조4천억원, 4억1천만건으로 각각 8.7%, 1.4% 증가했다.)
